segments.sn22.54:1.4: Mūlabījaṃ, khandhabījaṃ, aggabījaṃ, phalubījaṃ, bījabījaññeva pañcamaṃ.
segments.sn22.54:1.5: Imāni cassu, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni akhaṇḍāni apūtikāni avātātapahatāni sārādāni [sārādāyīni (katthaci)] sukhasayitāni, pathavī [paṭhavī (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ca nāssa, āpo ca nāssa;
segments.sn22.54:1.6: api numāni [api nu imāni (sī. pī.)], bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun”ti?
segments.sn22.54:1.8: “Imāni cassu, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni akhaṇḍāni … pe … sukhasayitāni, pathavī ca assa, āpo ca assa;
segments.sn22.54:1.9: api numāni, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun”ti?
segments.sn22.54:1.11: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātu, evaṃ catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo daṭṭhabbā.
segments.sn22.54:1.12: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, āpodhātu, evaṃ nandirāgo daṭṭhabbo.
segments.sn22.54:1.13: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni, evaṃ viññāṇaṃ sāhāraṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ”.
segments.sn22.54:2.1: “Rūpupayaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.sn22.54:2.2: Vedanupayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya … pe … saññupayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya … pe … saṅkhārupayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.sn22.54:3.2: ‘ahamaññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saññāya aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā upapattiṃ vā vuddhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññāpessāmī’ti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.sn22.54:4.1: “Rūpadhātuyā ceva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti.
segments.sn22.54:4.2: Rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
segments.sn22.54:4.3: Vedanādhātuyā ce … saññādhātuyā ce … saṅkhāradhātuyā ce … viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti.
segments.sn22.54:4.7: Rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
segments.sn22.54:4.9: Vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. Ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. Santusitattā na paritassati. Aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
segments.sn22.54:4.10: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Bhinnakālato paṭṭhāya bījaṃ bījatthāya na upakappati.
Avātātapahatānīti vātena ca ātapena ca na hatāni, nirojataṃ na pāpitāni.
Nirojañhi kasaṭaṃ bījaṃ bījatthāya na upakappati.
Sukhasayitānīti cattāro māse koṭṭhe pakkhittaniyāmeneva sukhaṃ sayitāni.
Catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyoti kammaviññāṇassa ārammaṇabhūtā rūpādayo cattāro khandhā.
Tañhi bījaṃ viya pathaviyaṃ ārammaṇapathaviyaṃ viruhati.
Tathā hi viropitaṃ taṃ kammaviññāṇaṃ paṭisandhiaṅkuruppādanasamatthaṃ hoti.
